title: Portuguese Sweet Potato Frittata
description: A warm and fluffy Portuguese dish featuring sweet potatoes, perfect for a brunch mood, diabetic friendly and cooked to perfection in a papillote, this sweet potato frittata combines the natural sweetness of sweet potatoes with the savory flavors of Portuguese cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until the onion is translucent.
Add the diced sweet potatoes to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour the whisked eggs over the sweet potato mixture in the skillet and cook until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes, or until the eggs are almost set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to carefully slide the frittata onto a plate and serve warm.
